pages.text: The Ogre King sells armor and tools made for ogres, cut down, if never quite to fit, for everyone else. Each is sold once to each player, for $(item)Golden Ogre Teeth$().$(br2)Their tooltips give the exact numbers.

pages.title: Brute's Helm
pages.text: Heavy iron taken from a Brute. On top of its armor, it adds to your maximum health.

pages.title: Ogre Loincloth
pages.text: Leg armor that is mostly attitude. Worn, it keeps Strength I and Resistance I on you.

pages.title: Bogsteel Chestplate
pages.text: Bog iron purified by ogres. Its chest defense beats netherite's, with a little less toughness. Now and then a blow glances off it and does no damage at all.

pages.title: Bogsteel Gauntlets
pages.text: Worn in the Hands curios slot, they give +2 armor, +1 toughness, +2 attack damage, +0.5 attack knockback and 15% knockback resistance, at the cost of 5% attack speed. Nothing about what you hold changes.

pages.title: Ogre Stomach
pages.text: Worn in a Curios slot, it lets you eat even when you are full, and every meal goes down instantly. Foods with effects, like a golden apple, can only be gulped once every ten seconds; between times they take their usual while.

pages.title: Timber
pages.text: The King's Bog Iron Axe already carries $(thing)Timber$(): chop one log and every log connected to it comes down, up to 128. Crouch to take just one.
